# Objective

Ship nine user-requested overlay changes in one batch (one CI drop at the end):

| # | Ask | Resolution |
|---|-----|------------|
| 1 | Show the actual clickable points inside the zone boxes (level 1) | Per-point dots in `HintCanvas.RenderGroupVisual` |
| 2 | One border line between boxes, not two | Zone-grid rendering: single outer rect + interior separators drawn once |
| 3 | `GroupZones` 5×5 → 4×6 | Default change across config/options/comments |
| 4 | `i` = insert mode (suspend), `q`/`Esc` exits | Reserve `I` like `Q` (24-letter alphabet); hook intercepts Esc/Q while suspended |
| 5 | Close after v/d/s completes | Snapshot follows `SelectionActionsClose` (Double/Triple/v already do) |
| 6 | Always-on quadrant guide I/O/J/K | New persistent click-through `QuadrantGuideWindow` per monitor; hotkeys stay F1–F4 (letters = user's AHK layer) |
| 7 | Portrait monitors: in-zone 4×6 not 6×4 | `TryDeriveZoneGrid` best-factorization vs aspect |
| 8 | Leader popup + badge don't scale on high-res | `ApplyChromeScale` LayoutTransform (DIU height / 1080, clamp ≥ 1) |
| 9 | hap "stops working" on elevated apps (v2rayN) | Single-instance mutex, surface `RegisterHotKey` failures, clicks → `SendInput` with injected-count check + BLOCKED badge, startup elevation log |

# Key decisions (user-confirmed)

- `I` is reserved (removed from `HintCharacters`) so plain `i` always enters insert
  mode — dim toggle moves to `<leader>x`. Numeric coherence: 24 letters ↔ 4×6 = 24
  zone keys × 6×4 = 24 in-zone labels = 576 = 24² labels; nothing wasted.
- The quadrant guide is **always visible** (persistent window), labels I/O/J/K from
  a new `QuadrantGuideLabels` config; hap hotkeys stay `Ctrl+Shift+F1..F4`.

# Approach per item

As approved in the session plan (see `~/.claude/plans/vast-plotting-thunder.md`);
summary: dots at `(br.Left, br.Top)` for PointHints; zone-grid path draws extent
union + `GroupBoxPad`-inflated outer rounded rect and single dotted separators at
`extent.Left + c*(extent.Width/cols)`; best-fit factorization
`min |c/r − aspect|` over `r = n/c`; `VK_I = 0x49` beside `VK_Q`; snapshot mirrors
`afterSelect`; guide window uses the OverlayView DPI counter-scale pattern;
chrome scale `clamp(Bounds.Height/_scaleY / 1080, 1, 3)`; item 9 ships
diagnostics + guards since the root cause can't be confirmed from Linux.

# Verification criteria

1. CI green (windows-latest MSBuild + vstest) after each commit.
2. On-box manual checklist: dots/single borders at level 1; 4×6 zones; portrait
   4×6 in-zone; `i`/`q`/`Esc` insert cycle; d/t/v/s close in Continuous; guide
   cross always visible + click-through; badge/leader ~2× on 4K; elevated-app
   click either lands or reports BLOCKED/duplicate-instance.
